title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and the translation vector set to zero, zero, and zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. The sketch consists of a loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (zero, zero) and ends at (zero point one four zero six, zero). The second line starts at (zero point one four zero six, zero) and ends at (zero point one four zero six, zero point zero three one two). The third line starts at (zero point one four zero six, zero point zero three one two) and ends at (zero, zero point zero three one two). The fourth line completes the loop by starting at (zero, zero point zero three one two) and ending at the origin (zero, zero). Apply a scaling factor of zero point one four zero six to the two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the sketch using the Euler angles negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and translate it using the translation vector zero, zero, and zero. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch to create a three-dimensional model. Extrude zero point seven five units in the direction of the normal without extruding in the opposite direction. This operation will create a new solid body with the following dimensions: length zero point one four zero six units, width zero point zero three one two five units, and height zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.1406, 0).lineTo(0.1406, 0.0312).lineTo(0, 0.0312).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are -90.0, 0.0, -90.0 and the translation vector is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
transformed_extrusion = extrusion.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = transformed_extrusion

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(0, 0, 0.0312))

# Create the sketch for the rectangular top
sketch = (
    workplane
    .lineTo(0.75, 0)  # line_1
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.1406)  # line_2
    .lineTo(0, 0.1406)  # line_3
    .lineTo(0, 0)  # line_4
    .close()  # Close the loop
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular top
extruded_shape = sketch.extrude(0.0312)

# The final model 'r' is the extruded shape
r = extruded_shape

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.1406) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1406) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.0312)
